prompts: Edit this sprite sheet into a compositing layer for the same bow knight. Preserve the exact matte six-color pixel-art design: dark navy short solid hair, ivory browguard/shoulders, blue-white torso armor, visible warm face and eye, brown quiver, crisp dark outline. IMPORTANT: remove every horse, saddle and rider leg. Show ONLY the rider upper body from hair to waist belt, arms, quiver, and COMPLETE large ivory recurved bow including both limbs and a visible bowstring. Transparent negative space below waist, no base, no text, no effects. All riders must keep identical torso/head geometry and be facing LEFT at the same three-quarter view, with the same waist location within each cell. These layers will be placed over ONE fixed horse; never draw a horse fragment or human leg. Bow should be mechanically readable, ivory limbs brown grip, thin clear taut string connecting actual top and bottom limb tips, two string segments to the arrow nock during drawing. Cell top-left: low diagonal bow held across waist, string unpulled, no loose arrow. Top-right: same low diagonal bow, rear hand preparing an arrow. Bottom-left: small foreshortened bow at chest and a horizontal arrow, preparing to lift. Bottom-right: bow lifted nearly upright, arrow at chest height, string gently pulled. Do not redesign the character. Draw connected shoulders/elbows/wrists with clear grasping hands. Keep each sprite well separated.
